scope: 2024 ICPC Hong Kong A B C D E F G H I J K L
limitations: Independent small-case and construction checks; no online submissions. Optimized complexity requires the data structures described in each text; reference validators favor clarity over maximum-scale performance.

A.method: 1500 random arrays and randomized checkpoint block widths versus direct center expansion

B.method: 300 random enemy systems versus memoized actual shield/health attack games, checking cost and count

C.method: all ternary arrays through length eight versus all legal reverse deletion branches

F.method: 120 small exhaustive one-use donation games plus 1000 random circles versus every split

G.method: random string multisets versus exhaustive disjoint team partitions for every team size

H.method: 150 random arrays versus recursive exact Pong/Chow decomposition for every interval

K.method: every LR source through length nine; full reachable deletion graph versus corrected formal-statement conditions

L.method: all grids through 3x3 against complete XOR span of paths plus 500 random boards through 200x200 with full construction replay

D.method: offline dynamic segment-tree unions/deletions versus actual path histories and exhaustive nonadjacent half-damage choices

I.method: 35 explicit original grouping/coloring games and 5000 smooth-order discrete-log/constant-time power checks against built-in modular exponentiation

J.method: 600 random tree pairs against direct recursive deletion-component reconstruction for every root

E.method: 530 general-position point sets, including dense interior points; enumerate all vertex subsets and simple polygon orders versus polar-sector prefix/suffix Graham area formula
